title: An Old Game and My Own

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
I found a rather interesting old game.  The Story of the Earth and Star.  It's not bad.  I wish I can find more games like them, though everything is now in archives. Not great, but lots of grammatical errors.
When you want to correct games and creativity.
Though on mine, Monster Enigma II-V, The Rise of Mordorra, I'm having a hard time trying to make it less like RPG Maker.  The skill is making it less like RPG Maker.  Much of the skills in the game now have an M- next to them, like M-Enflame.  Any tips?  :/  I also kinda wish, that 2003 had more monster battlers.  At least in that style.  Are there more??
